author: Codex design; OpenCode source binding

design.correction_cause: source category identity in parent authored design: gifts is absent, actual gift POI category is apparel_and_gifts
design.correction2_cause: parent review incorrectly assumed independent daily origins; current production contracts/decision008 explicitly carry prior last POI and charge next-day inbound travel
design.correction2_classification: parent oracle/protocol error, not demonstrated production bug
design.multi_day_semantics: Production contract: carry last scheduled POI as next day origin; empty day preserves origin; charge directed inbound travel after the new day start. No accommodation or traffic model, no invented route; existing actual pair matrix supplies the leg.

source.source_area_label_scope: source snapshot label only; not a verified current administrative boundary

route_provenance.quantization: Production adapter: distance nearest integer metre -> decimal km; duration nearest whole second -> ceil minute. Original GH float metres/milliseconds retained separately.
route_provenance.provenance: direct GraphHopper loopback GET only; no reverse/self edge inference, no synthetic edge, no model/engine call in this build

field_provenance.poi_id: exact prepared payload record id (internal local identity)
field_provenance.category_ids: exact source poi_categories ids in source order
field_provenance.visit_minutes: authored scenario assumption by pace profile; not a measured venue fact
field_provenance.opening_windows: projection of production parse_operation_time over authored dates; 24/7 becomes local 00:00 through next-day 00:00; absent/unsupported source hours remain empty/unknown
field_provenance.cost: always null; source price absent and never inferred as zero
field_provenance.budget: authored per_party VND request; not a source price and not evidence of budget feasibility
field_provenance.days.date: authored counterfactual itinerary date, not freshness evidence
field_provenance.days.window: authored request window with explicit +07:00 offset
field_provenance.days.meal_windows: authored request only on declared day_index
field_provenance.required_categories: authored request using exact source category ids
field_provenance.transport_mode: authored single mode for all route edges in a scenario
field_provenance.route_edges: actual successful directed GraphHopper responses for the exact selected pair and mode; no self edge, no reverse inference. Every cross-day leg is looked up from this same actual matrix using production multi-day semantics (prior last POI is the next-day origin); no inter-day edge is invented and no hotel/accommodation model is assumed
field_provenance.multi_day: Production contract: carry the last scheduled POI as next-day origin; an empty day preserves the origin; charge directed inbound travel after the new day start. No accommodation or traffic model, no invented route.
field_provenance.route_edges.distance_km: adapter_distance_km decimal string derived from nearest integer metres
field_provenance.route_edges.provenance: binds the full route snapshot SHA-256 and the exact response SHA-256
field_provenance.source_scope: exact explicit frozen source selection from the design
field_provenance.source_evidence: descriptive source name/coordinates/raw hours/category/lineage; price status explicitly unknown

limitations: All source prices, freshness, licence and source URL values are absent.
Hours are source-string projections on authored future dates, not fresh checks.
The eight-POI pool is purposive, not a population sample; P20 is a stress test.
Factors are confounded; no isolated mode/pace/budget effect is identifiable.
Multi-day travel follows production carry-origin semantics; no hotel, accommodation, traffic or overnight-verification claim is made.
The candidate is unfrozen and has not been independently reviewed or accepted.
